normal_day.description: Three employees at three fixed desks, 20 minutes, occasional short absences

occlusion.description: Two employees; one is occluded three times and ByteTrack issues a new track id each time

similar_clothing.description: Two employees in identical clothing with confusable appearance vectors: half the time at their own desks, half in a shared area where only appearance is available

chair_exits.description: One employee; three genuine chair exits over 90 s and one 40 s absence that must be rejected by the debounce

cross_camera.description: Two employees seated at their desks, making ten trips out to the corridor and pantry, with a cross-camera colour shift on the pantry camera

stranger.description: One employee plus an unenrolled visitor sitting at an unassigned desk — abstention here is the correct answer

hot_desking.description: Three employees sitting at each other's desks — the hot-desking case the seat prior is not designed for

overall.headline: 76% accurate on the 88% of cases above 0.75 confidence, correctly abstaining on the rest
